_comment: omatach adapter catalog: the OBDLink devices omatach supports, in the schema obd_session_rs's Catalog::resolve matches against. ble/classic/wifi namePatterns match the advertised device name; usb.namePatterns match the connector NAME the engine's serial probe mints: FTDI ports are reported as 'USB serial adapter (ttyUSB0)' / '(cu.usbserial-XXXX)', so any such port resolves to STN facts (supportsPeriodic) and the STI read at init confirms it.
